evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: four canopy nodes send amber dot-streams along hyphae into a central graphite web; by shot-08s a faded rust node at right has amber streams running toward it, so the reversal is visible.
evidence.ambition: shot-20s: eight radial nodes, rust shade bands forming an X, mirrored hyphae and glow halos on flat 2D line art; no spot pattern or material is visible, so ambition stays moderate.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: cream, ochre, rust and graphite palette is coherent and the node glows are soft, but the shade-band blobs have stair-stepped edges and shot-20s shows faint vertical banding in the background.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: a mycorrhizal sugar-flow idea on a cream ground is not in the anchor set and reads differently from the cards, birds and reaction rings, but the line art and glowing spheres are generic.
evidence.polish: shot-08s: hard cut to a closer frame leaves the right half empty and the faded node cropped; shot-20s resolves into a symmetric radial mirror that differs clearly from the 2s start.

pairwise_justification: No median archive exists yet, so there is no head-to-head comparison; the pairwise result defaults to true.
